    Word lists¶

    These lists are generated automatically from the project's lexicon (6650 entries). Words are grouped by semantic domain following the SIL Semantic Domains classification; a word may appear in several domains. Attested words link to their first occurrence in the Kisiei Bible; Confirmed words are not in the Bible but confirmed by a speaker; Respelled words come from an older written source (Keita 1979, Paulme 1964, the Lexique kissi–français, the Académie terminology, Sandara Kisia), converted to the current spelling; they still need confirmation; Southern Kissi words are known only from the Southern Kissi dictionary (Childs 2000): they are not attested in the North and are spelled as Childs writes them. The lexicon is also available as CSV, TSV, LIFT (for FieldWorks) and CLDF.

    1. Universe, creation¶

    Kisiei Category English Source
    cɔvɔɔ verb make; create; mould Gen 2:1

    1.1 Sky¶

    Kisiei Category English Source
    aliene noun sky Paulme 1964, p. 1
    còó noun (o) — Southern Kissi only sky, weather; the art of climbing palm trees
    halaa noun sky — Southern Kissi (Childs 2000) : cloud, sky, heavens; also the name of a spirit Keita 1979, p. 154; Paulme 1964, p. 33; Lexique kissi–français, p. 17
    halataalaa noun (o) sky; heaven; paradise Gen 1
    yálábóndáá noun (o) — Southern Kissi only frog species; rainbow

    1.1.1 Sun¶

    Kisiei Category English Source
    loei, pl. loeon noun (i) star Num 24:17
    mɔmtombolaa noun Pleiades (constellation) Job 9:9
    paale kalalen noun noon, midday sun Keita 1979, p. 154; Lexique kissi–français, p. 41
    paalen noun (len) sun; day; light — Southern Kissi (Childs 2000) : day, sun; midday, noon, afternoon Gen 1:14
    paangei noun (i) moon — Southern Kissi (Childs 2000) : moon, month; menstrual period Gen 1:16
    vɛindan noun sunrise (around 6-7 a.m.) Paulme 1964, p. 120
    vɛma paale noun morning sun's heat (around 8 a.m.) Paulme 1964, p. 120
    yilankunndo noun (o) meteor, shooting star Lexique kissi–français, p. 66
    ŋama-ŋama ideophone (ideophone) in full (of the sun: high, in full strength) Gen 29:7

    1.1.2 Air¶

    Kisiei Category English Source
